method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows South Africa with 甲 on the southwest coast. From the question, the ship travels in July from 甲 to Shanghai via the west coast of Australia. Split the route into South Africa → western Australia and western Australia → East/Southeast Asia → Shanghai. For the first leg, the ship mainly moves eastward across the southern Indian Ocean, matching the west-to-east westerlies. For the later leg, southeast trades and summer monsoon winds generally push toward northwest/north or from the south/southeast, broadly consistent with travel toward Shanghai. Therefore the voyage is mostly with the wind, so answer 顺风.
